title: Multimodal Analysis of Endomyocardial Biopsies

officials.a: Department of Cardiology and Vascular Medicine, West German Heart and Vascular Center Essen, University Hospital Essen, Germany

summary:
The goal of this observational study is to pursue a multimodal approach to identify the molecular signatures and immune signalling molecules of various myocardial diseases and thereby contribute to improving diagnosis and therapy.

The main aim is:

-Identification of molecular profiles (e.g., proteome, lipidome, metabolome) and immune signalling profiles that are specifically associated with different myocardial diseases and the post-heart transplantation course.

Participants already receiving an endomyocardial biopsy as part of their regular medical care will be enrolled. An additional biopsy sample will be taken for the above mentioned research.
desc: The proposed study aims to pursue a multimodal approach to identify the molecular signatures and immune signalling profiles of various myocardial diseases and thereby contribute to improving diagnosis and therapy. In the context of a clinically indicated endomyocardial biopsy (EMB), an additional EMB will be performed. This sample will be further analyzed using, among other methods, multi-omics, immune signalling analysis and nuclear cardiology analyses. These analyses are intended to enable the identification of genetic mutations, inflammatory gene expression patterns, immune signalling and protein alterations in myocardial diseases such as cardiomyopathies, myocarditis, and cardiac amyloidosis. Furthermore, the results will be correlated with established clinical parameters and biomarkers in order to identify novel diagnostic markers.
elig:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients aged \>18 years with a clinical indication for endomyocardial biopsy.
* Patients capable of providing informed consent who have signed the consent form for participation in the study.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients without a clinical indication for endomyocardial biopsy (EMB).
* Pregnant individuals.
* Patients incapable of providing informed consent.
* Women of childbearing potential who are not using adequate contraception.

arms.l: Patients undergoing endomyocardial biopsy following clinical indication
arms.d: All patients with a clinical indication for EMB without regard to certain disease types. Typically these patients are after heart transplantation, amyloidosi or with a cardiomyopathy, including dilated-, hypertrophic- or inflammatory cardiomyopathy.

primary.m: Spatial molecular profiles and immune signalling in all included patients

x.titre: Analyse multimodale de biopsies endomyocardiques (cardiomyopathies, amylose, myocardite, greffe)
x.question: Quels profils moléculaires et de signalisation immunitaire caractérisent les maladies du myocarde et le devenir après transplantation cardiaque ?
x.contexte:
La biopsie endomyocardique reste l'examen de référence pour typer certaines maladies myocardiques : myocardite, cardiomyopathies, amylose cardiaque, sarcoïdose, rejet de greffe. L'analyse histologique usuelle n'exploite qu'une petite partie de l'information contenue dans le prélèvement.

Les approches multi-omiques (protéome, lipidome, métabolome), l'analyse de la signalisation immunitaire et l'imagerie de médecine nucléaire peuvent identifier des signatures spécifiques de chaque maladie et de nouveaux marqueurs diagnostiques.

Cette étude observationnelle de l'hôpital universitaire d'Essen (Allemagne) inclut 216 adultes qui ont déjà une indication clinique de biopsie. Un prélèvement supplémentaire est réalisé pour la recherche. Les résultats sont corrélés aux paramètres cliniques et aux biomarqueurs établis.
x.interet: Elle pourrait faire émerger des marqueurs moléculaires utiles au diagnostic, par exemple dans l'amylose cardiaque ou la myocardite. Étude exploratoire, sans retombée clinique immédiate.
x.profil: Des adultes adressés pour une biopsie endomyocardique (greffe, cardiomyopathies, myocardite, amylose).
exclusion: Femme en âge de procréer sans contraception adéquate

bras.traitement: Biopsie supplémentaire pour analyses multi-omiques et immunitaires

x.critere: Profils moléculaires spatiaux et signalisation immunitaire chez tous les patients inclus, du départ à 1 an
